title: pager-sprintbacklog-memo-izumi-2026-06-01
content:
Daily on-call scratch + sprint-style backlog (quick memo) - Izumi - 2026-06-01

Morning summary:
- Shift: 06:30-15:00 PDT. Quiet first half; two pages during the 09:00 window.
- Primary theme: noisy downstream timeouts from cache tier causing elevated latency & duplicate retries.
- Paging count: 2 P2s (both transient), 3 P3s (alerts noise). No active Sev1s.

Pages (short notes):
1) 2026-06-01 09:12 - cache-read-timeout (alert: cache.read.latency.p95 > 300ms)
   - Symptom: upstream services saw 500/504 errors and increased request latency.
   - Quick action: flipped canary route to region-b fallback for 10m (route set: rwd-svc-canary -> rwd-svc-b).
   - Investigations: redis nodes in us-west-2 had intermittent CPU spikes; CloudWatch spike correlates with a backup job starting.
   - Evidence: trace ids: trace-7a2b3c, trace-7a2b7f (sampled in x-ray).
   - Temporary mitigation: adjusted backup window (ops-runbook link) and added retry-budget throttle to proxy (proxy.cfg: max_retries=2).
   - Follow-ups assigned: add scheduled-check for backup job overlap (owner: Nora Li, JIRA-4567).

2) 2026-06-01 09:44 - downstream-500-flurry (alert: service.response.errors > threshold)
   - Root cause hypothesis: cascade from cache timeouts + upstream aggressive retries causing request storms.
   - Immediate: enabled circuit-breaker for downstream-rerank (circuit: 30s open after 5 failures).
   - Notes: function-call traces show repeated replays from client-side SDK (v2.4.1). Potential SDK bug (issue filed GH-7890).

Runbook TODOs (short actionable items):
- [ ] runbook: cache-backup-overlap - add detection rule -> cron-job-overlap-alert (owner: Nora Li, due: 2026-06-04)
- [ ] runbook: SDK-retry-safety - document exponential backoff guidance for clients (owner: Izumi Tanaka, due: 2026-06-07)
- [ ] dashboard: create p95/p99 combined panel for cache + upstream to catch cascades (owner: Avi Patel, due: 2026-06-03)
- [ ] incident post-check: collect heap profiles from redis nodes during spike windows (owner: infra, note: low-risk)
- [ ] automation: add rate-limiter rule to edge proxy to cap client burst after N retries (owner: eng-serving-runtime, due: 2026-06-10)

Commands used / quick playbook excerpts:
- Check pods: kubectl -n production get pods -l app=redis-cache -o wide
- Tail logs (example): kubectl -n production logs deployment/cache-main -c cache --since=10m | grep "timeout"
- Proxy toggle (internal infra): curl -X POST https://ops-api.redwood.internal/v1/route/canary -d '{"route":"rwd-svc-b"}'  # use ops-token
- Sample trace query (X-Ray/Tempo): query traceId:trace-7a2b3c

Notes to self / weirdness observed:
- Backup job configured in infra-Git repo had a new schedule merge on 2026-05-29 (PR #234) that bumped concurrency. Might have slipped past our preflight.
- Client SDK (v2.4.1) seems to not apply jitter correctly; repro steps noted in GH-7890 comment. Suggest adding minimal repro test in e2e suite.
- Alert noise: a flapping rule for "high error rate" triggers when p95 spikes briefly; consider adding an adaptive suppression window for short-lived spikes.

Hand-off items for next oncall (evening shift):
- Ensure the canary route remains at rwd-svc-b until backup window corrected.
- Check JIRA-4567 for confirmation that the backup job detection rule is deployed.
- Watch for SDK rollout metrics; client update may reduce retry storms.

Sprint backlog (short living tickets to pick up from runbook):
- SPRINT-TODO-1: Add backup-overlap detection (labels: oncall, infra, p2) - estimate: 3d
- SPRINT-TODO-2: SDK-retry-proof guide + sample client config (labels: devexp, p3) - estimate: 2d
- SPRINT-TODO-3: Edge-proxy rate-limiter prototype and dogfood (labels: serving-runtime, p2) - estimate: 4d

Post-incident quick RCF (rough):
- Root cause: backup job concurrency increase -> redis CPU spike -> cache read p95 up -> upstream retries -> downstream request storms.
- Contributing: missing detection rule + noisy alerting + client SDK retry behavior.
- Immediate fixes: backup schedule revert / add guardrail; circuit-breaker + rate-limiter; doc SDK guidance.

Random TODOs / personal reminders:
- Ping infra-team about PR #234 review notes (short message: "possible backup concurrency regression")
- Add a small runbook section: how to flip canary routes via ops-api (copy snippet into confluence runbook)
- Clean up personal oncall scratchpad folder (archive older than May 2026)

End-of-shift quick status (15:00 PDT):
- State: mitigations in place, monitoring panels live, follow-ups assigned. No ongoing customer-facing degradation.
- Next steps for me: draft short "post-incident seeds" doc for postmortem; start a timeline (will upload to JIRA-4567).

---
Raw references / links to copy into tickets: 
- Ops API route toggle: https://ops-api.redwood.internal/v1/route/canary
- PR that changed backup schedule: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/234
- Client SDK issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/7890
- Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/cache-cascade

End of memo.
